{{infobox Chinese|l=Yang Earth Tiger|kanji=戊寅|romaji=tsuchinoe tora|onyomi=boin|p=wùyín|w=wu-yin|mi=u⁵⁵ ʈ͡ʂʰin²¹|y=mou6 jan4|j=mou6 jan4|ci=mɐu jɐn|mc=məu in|oc-bs=mə ʔin}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yang Earth Tiger''' (戊寅, ''tsuchinoe tora''; onyomi ''boin'') is the 15th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 15th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Fire Ox|ja|丁丑|1=Yin Fire Ox}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Earth Rabbit|ja|己卯|1=Yin Earth Rabbit}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''戊'' is Yang Earth, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''寅'' (Tiger) is Yang Wood; together they form a Mutual Destruction relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Earth Tiger (戊寅)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): wùyín
** Cantonese (Jyutping): mou6 jan4
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: tsuchinoe-tora
*** On'yomi: boin
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): muin (무인)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Mậu Dần

==Months of Yang Earth Tiger==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 0 or 5 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Kō|ja|庚|1=Kanoe (庚)|lt=Kanoe (庚)|2=ja|3=庚|4=zh|5=庚|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kō}} or {{ill|Etsu|ja|乙|1=Kinoto (乙)|lt=Kinoto (乙)|2=ja|3=乙|4=zh|5=乙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Etsu}}), the month of {{ill|January|en|January|qid=Q108|lt=January|1=January}} is designated as the Bointora {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month|1=Month}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Lichun|en|Lichun|qid=Q1364685|lt=Risshun|1=Lichun}} until the day before {{ill|Jingzhe|en|Jingzhe|qid=Q1306596|lt=Awakening of Insects|1=Jingzhe}}) as applicable.
